regime.instructions: Which market regime best describes SKY right now? State is a compact numeric snapshot of the SKY-USDT-SWAP perpetual: order book (px), returns in bps (ret_bps), realized vol (vol), trade flow (flow), our position (pos), fundamentals (fund) and market context (mkt). Thesis: Sky earns a spread on USDS reserves, so higher policy rates (a hike is priced for 2026-12-09) support revenue; 9.6x price/holders-revenue with holders revenue +86% month over month and 99% float. Bear case: Revenue depends on USDS supply, and stablecoin supply fell 5.8% in 30 days; buybacks were cut sharply in March 2026; governance can redirect revenue.

criteria.trending: Persistent directional move: returns over 1h and 4h share a sign and vol is normal for this asset.
criteria.mean_reverting: Range-bound: short-term moves fade, returns flip sign, vol at or below its 24h level.
criteria.high_vol: Volatility well above its 24h level (vol.ratio high) without disorderly market structure.
criteria.crisis: Disorderly: large 24h drawdown, very high vol, wide spreads or thin depth, one-sided flow, market-wide stress.

criteria.long: Rises: rates-up regime favours yield-bearing protocol revenue; buyback flow on the bid.
criteria.short: Falls: stablecoin outflows shrink USDS and revenue; broad risk-off selling.
criteria.neutral: No edge after costs, signals conflict, or the move has already happened.

toxic_flow.instructions: Recent SKY order flow looks informed or one-sided enough that a position opened now would likely be adversely selected (sweeps through levels, sudden spread widening, trade bursts against the resting book).

State is a compact numeric snapshot of the SKY-USDT-SWAP perpetual: order book (px), returns in bps (ret_bps), realized vol (vol), trade flow (flow), our position (pos), fundamentals (fund) and market context (mkt). Thesis: Sky earns a spread on USDS reserves, so higher policy rates (a hike is priced for 2026-12-09) support revenue; 9.6x price/holders-revenue with holders revenue +86% month over month and 99% float. criteria: No setup: conflicting signals, thin or unstable book, or the move already happened.
Weak: one supporting signal, others neutral or mixed.
Good: price action, order flow and fundamentals agree on direction; liquidity is adequate.
Excellent: strong agreement across flow, regime and fundamentals, tight spread, no conflicting risk.

risk_state.instructions: Given our position, drawdown and daily P&L in pos, what is the risk state for SKY?

criteria.safe: Comfortable room: small inventory, shallow drawdown, daily P&L not near a loss limit.
criteria.near_limit: Drawdown, daily loss or inventory is approaching the levels where we would have to cut.
criteria.reduce: Exposure should be cut now: losses accelerating or inventory too large for current conditions.
